tools.name: freshdesk_list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets, newest activity first by default. Returns one page. By default Freshdesk only lists tickets created in the last 30 days; pass updated_since to reach older ones. The status filter applies to the returned page only; use freshdesk_search_tickets to filter across all tickets.

include_requester.description: Include the requester (name, masked email and phone).

status.description: Keep only tickets with this status (applied to this page).

updated_since.description: Only tickets updated after this time, as 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T09:00:00Z.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by number, with its requester. Optionally include the first batch of replies; Freshdesk limits how many it embeds, so use freshdesk_list_conversations for a long thread.

include_conversations.description: Also include the first replies and notes.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with Freshdesk's query syntax, for example: status:2 AND priority:3, or tag:'refund', or created_at:>'2026-01-01'. Use single quotes for text values. Results come 30 per page and Freshdesk allows at most 10 pages, so at most 300 matches are reachable; narrow the query instead of paging deeper. Status codes: 2 open, 3 pending, 4 resolved, 5 closed. Priority codes: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 urgent.

query.description: Freshdesk search query, without surrounding double quotes. Max 500 characters.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_conversations
tools.description: List the replies and internal notes on a ticket, oldest first. incoming=true means the customer wrote it; private=true means it is an internal note.

tools.name: freshdesk_ticket_brief
tools.description: A short, rule-based summary of one ticket: who is waiting and for how long, the customer's last message, whether it is past its due time, warning signs, and a suggested next step. Computed locally from the ticket and its replies; no AI service is used. The suggestion is a hint for a person or agent to review, not an action taken.

tools.name: freshdesk_find_similar_tickets
tools.description: Find tickets that look related to a given ticket by comparing their words (TF-IDF), and say which shared words caused each match. It compares against the most recently updated tickets Freshdesk returns (by default only the last 30 days; pass updated_since to look further back), so it is a quick lead, not a complete duplicate check. Computed locally; no AI service is used.

candidate_pages.description: How many pages of 100 recent tickets to compare against.

updated_since.description: Compare against tickets updated after this date, as 2026-01-31.
